Definition: Whether the Ministry of Finance has oversight of the financing and development of the digital ID system
Comments: The World Bank EDGE project PID (2021) states that 'an Inter-Ministerial Digital Spending Controls Committee anchored at the Ministry of Finance' will enforce oversight of digital standards. The Ministry of Finance is involved in the EDGE Project Implementation Steering Committee. However, systematic Ministry of Finance oversight specifically of the ID system is not documented as a standalone function. Finance oversight is partial and primarily exercised through the World Bank-funded EDGE project coordination.
